How Savings Affect Your Cash Balance

• Contributions reduce your available cash and increase your savings balance.
• Withdrawals increase your available cash and reduce your savings balance.
• Neither transaction is treated as an expense or income.
• Savings transfers should not be counted twice in your financial reports.
